propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step failures in review-plan runs are invisible to callers because they produce no counter in the verdict JSON, only silent logger.warning statements at ~13 swallow sites across src/rebar/llm/
The verdict coverage object lacks a field to track survived LLM failures: resolution_class fires only on fatal degradation and chunk_errors is write-only without readers
A new run-scoped contextvars sink in step_failures.py records LLM failures at the runner.py seam and drains them into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty, preserving attestation-safety
The drain populates coverage.llm_step_failures with shape {total: int, by_step: {call_label: int}} keyed by runner _call_label for grep-ability, presented only in the text renderer when present
Recording is non-fatal observability only: no retry, no control flow change, no verdict or exit-code effect; fatal failures abort the run before reaching the drain
